jsmore.configuration.title: JS More Config
jsmore.configuration.debug_logging.toolt: Writes additional JS More diagnostics to the log for troubleshooting.
jsmore.configuration.disable_jurassicsag: Off by default. A simple fallback for conflicts with other biome mods. Restart the game or server after changing this; existing chunks are unaffected. Legacy settings reset once when upgrading to the stable release.
jsmore.configuration.config_schema_versi: Managed by JS More. Leave this unchanged to preserve your biome-generation choice after migration.
jsmore.configuration.prevent_jurassicsag: On by default. Keeps Jurassic Saga land and water creatures from despawning with distance or inactivity. Disable to restore upstream behavior. Restart the world or server to apply.
jsmore.configuration.enable_player_fed_b: On by default. Requires eligible feeding for breeding and fertile periodic eggs. Disable to restore upstream rules; pending eggs are kept until re-enabled. Restart the world or server to apply.
